text:
Mika: Heads-up — PR #46899 (adaptive routing + authz header fallback) is ready for cross-team review. Need: 2x runtime LGTM, infra signoff, security signoff. Plan to merge Tue 09:00 PT (~2024-03-05 16:00 UTC). Can runtime/platform/infra/security nominate owners? Quick context: this adds a header-order fallback so requests don't drop to slow path under partial auth failures. Small change but touches routing and auth headers.

Devon: I can take runtime owner. I'll validate KV cache interactions + run perf smoke.

Priya: Platform: I'm out on that morning until 10:00 PT. Can we shift merge to 10:30 PT or have a canary steward? There's an existing canary at 09:30.

Omar: Infra - I'll do infra review. Quick Q: any new IAM/KMS scopes?

Mika: No new KMS. Only reads existing header and toggles route. Config snippet:
```
route_fallback:
  header_priority: ["x-user-auth", "x-api-key"]
  evict_on_missing: false
```
CI: https://ci/reports/46899
Test command: `./scripts/run-smoke --filter=adaptive_routing`

Sasha: Security - happy to review. Need a short threat model and unit test proving header reorder doesn't leak cross-tenant values. @Mika can you add a short note?

Mika: Adding threat model to PR description now; added unit test link. Also tagging @Eli as canary steward per Priya request.

Devon: :+1: I'll post perf numbers by EOD and run canary prep.

ci-bot: snyk-scan: no vulnerabilities found (scan-id: SNYK-2024-001).

Priya: Thanks. If canary steward confirms, shifting merge to 10:30 PT works for platform.

Sasha: I'll aim to finish security review by 08:30 PT.

Mika: Owners: runtime -> Devon, infra -> Omar, platform -> Priya (merge timing negotiable), security -> Sasha. Canary steward -> Eli. If anyone needs a rollback owner, nominate now.

Omar: Rollback owner: Omar + infra runbook ok for me. I'll write rollback steps in PR.

Devon: I'll attach perf diff and a short rollback checklist.

Priya: LGTM pending security signoff. Thanks.

Sasha: Security LGTM after minor comment on header sanitizer — addressed.

Mika: Awesome, thanks all. Scheduling merge 10:30 PT if nothing else blocks. :rocket:
